column1: # gate-rules.tsv -- the rules the output gate scripts report, one row per rule.
# Read by check-branch-output.sh and check-pr-output.sh to fill a finding's
# rule_ref, and checked by gate-rule-refs_test.sh. Tab-separated columns:
#   rule_id   the stable name a finding carries as `rule_id`. Once emitted it
#             never changes; a rule whose meaning changes gets a new name.
#   ref       `<path>#L<start>-L<end>`, the rule's text in this repository.
#   commit    the 12-character commit the ref was pinned at; a finding prints
#   excerpt   text that occurs inside the ref's line range. The test fails when
#             an edit moves it out, and the fix updates ref and commit, never
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
